summary: Tested AURION fiscal system ICMS flags feature. Backend API working correctly - flags desconsiderar_icms_despesas and desconsiderar_icms_st properly exclude ICMS values from CFOPs de despesa and ST. Frontend displays 'Valores Desconsiderados na Apuração' card with correct values. Crédito ICMS reduced from R$ 2.072.412,90 to R$ 1.728.559,76 when flags are enabled.
passed_tests: Company selection - COMERCIAL RS LTDA - SUCCESS
API /api/apuracao-icms/{company_id} returns correct data with flags
API returns desconsiderados section with correct values (despesas: R$ 93.785,18, st: R$ 250.067,96, total: R$ 343.853,14)
API returns CFOPs with desconsiderado=True when flags are enabled (1403, 1556, 2403, 1551, 2551, 2556, 1411, 1653, 1407, 1406)
API returns is_despesa and is_st flags for each CFOP
Frontend displays 'Valores Desconsiderados na Apuração' card with correct values
Frontend shows ICMS Despesas (Zerado): R$ 93.785,18 - 155 itens afetados
Frontend shows ICMS ST (Zerado): R$ 250.067,96 - 435 itens afetados
Frontend shows Total ICMS Desconsiderado: R$ 343.853,14
Frontend shows reduced Crédito ICMS: R$ 1.728.559,76 (from R$ 2.072.412,90)
Frontend shows ICMS a Pagar: R$ 211.125,27
Frontend shows Status column in CFOP table with badges (Normal, Despesa, ST, DESCONSIDERADO)
API /api/companies/{id} PUT endpoint updates flags correctly
Company flags desconsiderar_icms_despesas and desconsiderar_icms_st are editable
critical_code_review_comments: Backend API correctly implements ICMS flags logic
Frontend correctly displays desconsiderados card and reduced ICMS values
Status column with badges (Normal, Despesa, ST, DESCONSIDERADO) is implemented
Red line-through styling for desconsiderado CFOPs is implemented in code
seed_data_creation: Used existing company COMERCIAL RS LTDA with competência 01/2026. Enabled both flags (desconsiderar_icms_despesas and desconsiderar_icms_st) for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ICMS flags feature is working correctly. Backend API returns correct data with desconsiderados section. Frontend displays 'Valores Desconsiderados na Apuração' card with correct values. The ENTRADAS section contains the desconsiderado CFOPs (1403, 1556, etc.) with red styling and badges. Both flags are currently enabled for the test company COMERCIAL RS LTDA.
